description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements a logging node that wraps Android's native Log utility. It serves as a connected node in a logging chain to output log messages and pass them along to other nodes if configured.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native logging utility, implementing the LogNode interface, capable of logging messages and forwarding logs to other nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to receive logged messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs messages using Android's Log.println and forwards the message to the next node if present.
